$comment: Fixture plugins for scripts/seed.ts. Every entry mirrors what the live indexer assembles: the raw plugin.json manifest (stored as an object; seed.ts stringifies it for the raw-text field), repo metadata, discovered skills (dirName + SKILL.md frontmatter), and the mcp.json body. All repos and orgs are fictional.

manifest.name: review-sentinel
manifest.description: Code review skills for agent workflows: diff triage, test-gap detection, and API surface checks that run before a human ever opens the PR.

frontmatter.name: pr-review
frontmatter.description: Review a pull request diff for correctness, missing tests, and unreviewed API surface changes.

frontmatter.name: security-pass
frontmatter.description: Second-pass review focused on injection risks, authz checks, and unsafe deserialization in the diff.

frontmatter.name: changelog-check
frontmatter.description: Verify the changelog entry matches the actual change and flags breaking changes explicitly.

manifest.name: docsmith
manifest.description: Keeps READMEs, API references, and changelogs in sync with the code they describe. Regenerates only the sections that drifted.

frontmatter.name: api-reference
frontmatter.description: Regenerate API reference sections from exported symbols, preserving hand-written prose between markers.

frontmatter.name: readme-refresh
frontmatter.description: Detect drift between the README and the current CLI flags, config options, and examples, then patch it.

frontmatter.name: changelog
frontmatter.description: Draft a changelog entry from merged commits since the last tag, grouped by change type.

manifest.name: commit-kit
manifest.description: Splits messy working trees into reviewable commits and writes Conventional Commits messages that actually describe the change.

frontmatter.name: write-commit
frontmatter.description: Write a Conventional Commits message for the staged diff, with scope inferred from touched packages.

frontmatter.name: split-diff
frontmatter.description: Partition an oversized working tree into independent, individually revertable commits.

manifest.name: migration-lint
manifest.description: Reviews SQL migrations for lock-heavy DDL, missing indexes on new foreign keys, and irreversible operations before they hit production.

frontmatter.name: review-migration
frontmatter.description: Lint a migration file for table locks, full rewrites, and unindexed foreign keys, with per-engine notes.

frontmatter.name: rollback-plan
frontmatter.description: Produce a tested down-migration or a documented reason why the change is irreversible.

manifest.name: a11y-sweep
manifest.description: Accessibility audit skills: WCAG 2.2 page audits, contrast fixes, and ARIA reviews that produce concrete patches instead of checklists.

frontmatter.name: audit-page
frontmatter.description: Run a WCAG 2.2 AA audit against a rendered page and rank findings by user impact.

frontmatter.name: fix-contrast
frontmatter.description: Propose minimal palette adjustments that bring failing text and UI contrast ratios into compliance.

frontmatter.name: aria-review
frontmatter.description: Check ARIA usage against the first rule of ARIA: prefer native elements, remove redundant roles.

manifest.name: pg.bridge
manifest.description: MCP server for Postgres: introspect schemas, explain query plans, and run read-only queries over stdio. No ORM, no magic.

manifest.name: gridwatch
manifest.description: Exposes dashboards, alert state, and SLO burn rates from your observability stack to agents over streamable HTTP.

manifest.name: tracefeed
manifest.description: Streams distributed traces to agents over SSE so they can watch a deploy settle in real time. Pairs well with an incident-response skill.

manifest.name: headless-pilot
manifest.description: Drives headless Chromium and Firefox over MCP. Navigate, screenshot, and assert on real pages without pulling in a test framework.

manifest.name: ticketflow
manifest.description: Issue tracker integration for agents: search and file tickets over HTTP, with a local stdio cache server for offline triage.

manifest.name: test-pilot
manifest.description: Generates unit tests from real call sites, hunts flaky tests by rerunning suspects in isolation, and exposes coverage data over MCP.

frontmatter.name: generate-tests
frontmatter.description: Write unit tests for a module using its real call sites as the source of expected behavior.

frontmatter.name: flaky-hunt
frontmatter.description: Rerun suspected flaky tests in isolation, bisect ordering dependencies, and report the true culprit.

manifest.name: argus-scan
manifest.description: Dependency and secret scanning for agent workflows. Skills audit lockfiles and diffs; the MCP server serves a live advisory feed.

frontmatter.name: dependency-audit
frontmatter.description: Audit lockfile changes against known advisories and flag newly introduced transitive risk.

frontmatter.name: secret-scan
frontmatter.description: Scan a diff for committed credentials and produce rotation steps for anything found.

manifest.name: frameshift
manifest.description: Data-wrangling skills backed by an embedded DuckDB MCP server. Profile a dataset first, then clean it column by column.

frontmatter.name: profile-dataset
frontmatter.description: Summarize a dataset's shape, null rates, cardinality, and outliers before any transformation.

frontmatter.name: clean-columns
frontmatter.description: Normalize types, trim strings, and reconcile categorical values one column at a time, with a diff of every change.

manifest.name: deploy-captain
manifest.description: Rollout planning and incident notes as skills, plus an SSE feed of fleet deploy events so agents can see what shipped where.

frontmatter.name: rollout-plan
frontmatter.description: Draft a staged rollout plan with health gates, bake times, and an explicit abort threshold.

frontmatter.name: incident-note
frontmatter.description: Write a factual incident note from the deploy timeline: what shipped, what broke, what rolled back.

manifest.name: apiscribe
manifest.description: OpenAPI-first API documentation. Skills keep specs, prose, and SDK examples in sync; an MCP server serves the spec registry.

frontmatter.name: openapi-sync
frontmatter.description: Diff the OpenAPI spec against handler signatures and update whichever side is stale.

frontmatter.name: endpoint-docs
frontmatter.description: Write endpoint documentation with realistic request/response examples pulled from the spec's schemas.

frontmatter.name: sdk-examples
frontmatter.description: Generate copy-pasteable SDK snippets per endpoint for each configured language target.
